radix4_compute.selection_basis: Optimized reconstruction with a conflict-free shared layout, vector loads/stores, and 21 invariant coefficient pairs prepared once per kernel launch before repetition. The difference-based timing excludes coefficient preparation; this does not recover the original paper source or its 0.0120 ms experiment.

register_branch.selection_basis: Derived complete FFT using the 51e346c data mapping and the equivalent three conditional-swap permutation from pre-divergence checkpoint 652808b. Each of the three lane-dependent condition checks is applied across all eight disjoint quartets per stage, preserving conditional branches, exact permutations and all 48 MMAs. All 28 distinct MMA coefficient pairs are initialized once before repetition, matching shared_stage_radix4 timing scope. Source hashes identify this optimized reconstruction; neither the unmodified checkpoint nor original paper-stage identity is claimed.

Difference-based timing excludes coefficient preparation. Identified by source SHA-256, not a recovered historical commit.

candidate_implementations.title: Derived register FFT with grouped checkpoint permutation branches and cached coefficients
candidate_implementations.source_selection_basis: Derived complete FFT with 51e346c data mapping and the three-condition permutation from 652808b before 403c6ae reduce divergence. Each condition covers eight disjoint quartets per stage, retaining lane-dependent branches, every permutation and all 48 MMAs. All 28 distinct coefficient pairs are initialized and cached before repetition. Difference-based timing excludes coefficient preparation, matching shared_stage_radix4. Exact source hashes identify this optimization; older ungrouped cached measurements do not fill this row.
